mapper.select: select a.ASS_ID as assId, sum(IF(b.DICT_TYPE = 1,a.REAL_SCORE,0)) as addScore, sum(IF(b.DICT_TYPE = 2,a.REAL_SCORE,0)) as minusScore from BIZ_DEPT_ASS_RECORDS a join BIZ_DEPT_ASS_DICT b on a.DICT_ID = b.ID where a.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' and a.ASS_ID = #{assId} group by a.ASS_ID

select a.*, b.DICT_TYPE as dictType,b.DICT_NAME as dictName,b.DICT_SCORE as dictScore,b.DICT_DESCRIPTION as dictDescription from BIZ_DEPT_ASS_RECORDS a left join BIZ_DEPT_ASS_DICT b on a.DICT_ID = b.ID ${ew.customSqlSegment}

select a.*, b.DICT_TYPE as dictType,b.DICT_NAME as dictName,b.DICT_SCORE as dictScore,b.DICT_DESCRIPTION as dictDescription from BIZ_DEPT_ASS_RECORDS a left join BIZ_DEPT_ASS_DICT b on a.DICT_ID = b.ID where a.ID = #{id}
